title: Trading
description: Training on probability, game theory, and market making. We meet weekly to play various trading games, from paper markets to card games.

title: Dev
description: Python and C++ fundamentals, working with complex market data, backtesting frameworks, low-level systems, and networking.

title: Math
description: Preparing for the Putnam exam by reviewing competition math concepts and problems. Proof writing, algebra, combinatorics, analysis, etc.

title: Hardware
description: Introduction to low-latency systems: FPGAs, ASICs, and networking. Hands-on labs with real development boards.
